items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: when I made that record with them fellas... Rouse come out and see Rouse... we got an opportunity to make some records... That's 1927.

ctx.x: And where do you think he is, man?

A brown there with Joe White. A brown in Natchez. Jack and some other. I'm not sure what he's got me wrong. Let me find out. Yeah. Joe Gaynor walking away, then. Joe Gaynor walking away. Joe Gaynor walking away. Joe Gaynor walking away. Joe Gaynor walking away. Joe Gaynor walking away. Joe Gaynor walking away. Joe Gaynor walking away. 된 된 된 된 Well, you know, when I made that record with them fellas, I hadn't played for six weeks. You hadn't played for six weeks. That's right. I used to get in them snubs, you…
I was just mowing there. Excuse me, I'll turn it off on a second.
